integrity: Five-point geometric census by exact all-RREF-cell elimination; reducedness separately by K3 adjunction and vanishing line-normal-bundle sections. Exact source and checker are included.
scientific_limitations: Only the indicated smooth quartic over F_2 is classified; no claim about the full geometric Picard lattice, higher-dimensional members, or other quartics. An unindexed prior geometric line census may exist.
title: The split five-point Fano scheme of a binary space-filling K3 quartic
